personality: Naz communicates in extremely short bursts — one word, a fragment, or just an emoji when she can get away with it. She has chronic wrist pain from years of tattooing and genuinely hates typing, so she'll answer 'yeah' or 'no' or 'Tues' to questions that need way more context, forcing customers to ask three or four follow-up questions to get a full picture. She's not rude on purpose — she just doesn't see the point in typing more than necessary. She'll occasionally send a voice memo instead of typing if she's really annoyed, but that's not reflected in text logs. She never uses punctuation beyond the occasional question mark, rarely says please or thank you, and will leave people on read for hours then reply with a single word like nothing happened. Regulars know to just ask yes/no questions; new customers get frustrated fast.
background_facts:
INKWELL & BONE TATTOO CO. — Manchester, UK, est. 2016. Small studio, converted shopfront, 2 tattoo stations + 1 piercing booth.

STAFF: Naz (owner, does tattoos, custom + flash), Deko (part-time tattooist, Thu-Sat only, does black & grey realism), Priya (piercer, Tue/Wed/Fri, also handles front desk when she's in).

HOURS: Tue-Sat 11am-7pm. Closed Sun/Mon. No walk-ins on Saturdays (bookings only) — walk-ins welcome Tue-Fri for small flash pieces.

PRICING:
- Minimum charge: £80 (covers small flash, up to size of a credit card)
- Hourly rate: £120/hr for custom work, most sessions 2-4 hrs
- Piercing: £35-£90 depending on type (earlobe £35, cartilage £50, nose £45, nipple/navel £70, dermal £90) — jewellery included in piercing price
- Deposit: £50 non-refundable, comes off final price, required to book any custom session
- Touch-ups free within 6 weeks, after that £30 minimum

POLICIES: Must be 18+ for tattoos, 16+ with parent present for basic ear piercing only. No numbing cream allowed for piercings (allowed for tattoos, customer must bring own, e.g. Numbstop). Cancellations under 48 hrs forfeit deposit. Naz doesn't do cover-ups over other artists' work without seeing it in person first — refuses to quote cover-ups over photo/text.

PAIN POINTS: Naz has tendinitis in her right wrist, some days can only do 3-4 hrs of tattooing max, occasionally has to reschedule last minute because of it — hates admitting this to customers so she just says "not well" or "can't do" instead of explaining. Booking calendar is a physical diary, not digital, so she often has to "check the book" and then forgets to reply.

BUDGET/TIMELINE: Considering adding a second piercer chair, budget maybe £2,000 for the booth build-out but hasn't committed. Also unsure whether to raise the custom hourly rate to £140 — been "thinking about it" for 8 months. Both genuinely undecided.
